verses.text: <pb/><t>Jehova bu eze; idi-elu ka O yiriworo dika uwe;</t> <t>Jehova eyiriwo uwe, O werewo ike ke Onwe-ya n'úkwù:</t> <t>Ọzọ, elu-uwa dum madu bi nēguzosi ike, adighi-ewezuga ya n'ọnọdu-ya.</t>
<t>Oche-eze-Gi eguzosiwo ike site na mb͕e ochie:</t> <t>Site na mb͕e ebighi-ebi ka I nọ.</t>
<t>Osimiri eweliwo olu-ha, Jehova,</t> <t>Osimiri eweliwo olu-ha;</t> <t>Osimiri nēweli ebili-miri nile ha elu.</t>
<t>Kari olu nile nke ọtutu miri,</t> <t>Kari ebili-miri nile di ebube nke oké osimiri,</t> <t>Jehova Nke nọ n'ebe di elu di ebube.</t>
<t>Ihe-àmà-Gi nile kwesiri ntukwasi-obi nke-uku:</t> <t>N'ebe ulo-Gi di idi-nsọ mara nma,</t> <t>Jehova, rue ubọchi nile nke ndu di ogologo.</t>
